summary: The fresh T3A cold read found six incomplete contract surfaces. The amended decomposition and task plan now include every turn-context consumer and typed test adapter, isolate chat status filtering from /compact, require real DeepAgents checkpoint and both scheduled-job proofs, fail closed for unknown provider rows before ordering and limiting, and carry a review budget sized for the complete producer-consumer update. The ledgered closing round confirmed all six resolutions and an empty frontier.
gaps: Write scope omitted live-recovery-coordinator.ts and inline-agent-task-lifecycle.ts even though both read turn context and can trigger provider-session lifecycle effects.
The required continuity field could not be added exhaustively because concrete integration and e2e test adapters lived outside the recorded write scope.
Chat /status had neither a designed status-only continuity filter nor a command-path test, while filtering the shared compaction context could incorrectly change /compact before T3C.
AC3's real DeepAgents checkpoint-resume and Claude and DeepAgents scheduled-job guarantees were not selected by required tests or verify commands.
Unknown or removed provider rows had no defined read policy, allowing status to throw or accidentally treat an unregistered provider as durable.
The 30-file and 2600-line review budget was too small for the complete continuity producer-consumer and proof surface.
resolutions: The write scope now includes live-recovery-coordinator.ts, inline-agent-task-lifecycle.ts, and runtime-services.ts for adapter-registry wiring; required tests pin recovered and inline task turns before provider-session linkage or lifecycle.
The write scope now includes the concrete e2e and integration fixture files; every concrete and test adapter must declare continuity explicitly with no permissive default.
The contract now requires a chat /status-only filter and a session-commands regression proving /compact admission is unchanged until T3C.
Required tests now include the real Postgres-backed DeepAgents gateway checkpoint persistence/resume leaf and both Claude and DeepAgents scheduled-job leaves.
Unknown or removed provider rows are excluded fail-closed from read-only status and resume projections before ordering and limiting through the registered durable-provider allowlist.
The review budget is raised to 40 files and 3600 lines for the complete producer-consumer update; the later reconstruction, compaction, release, cleanup, and API-typing tasks remain split.
new_abstractions: ProviderSessionContinuity: adapter-owned process_local | durable_resume capability consumed before selection, linkage, lifecycle, failover, persistence, and projection.
Registered durable-provider allowlist: a fail-closed read policy derived from registered adapters for status and resume projections.
current_flow: Today live recovery and inline task lifecycle can read canonical turn context before continuity is known; live execution may then attach the selected provider row to a run; runner failover can share resume and persistence state; Claude worker and inline lanes resume and persist SDK sessions; and both public status and chat /status can expose stale provider-derived state. T3A resolves the adapter capability before those effects, makes every Claude attempt process-local while preserving the live worker MessageStream, and leaves DeepAgents checkpoint continuity durable.

rounds.question: The fresh T3A task grill found six blockers. The contract is now amended so: (1) live recovery and inline-task lifecycle are scoped as continuity consumers; (2) every concrete and integration-test adapter must declare continuity explicitly; (3) chat /status gets a status-only filter that does not change /compact before T3C; (4) real DeepAgents checkpoint resume plus Claude and DeepAgents scheduled-job leaves are mandatory; (5) unknown or removed provider rows are excluded fail-closed from read-only status/resume projections before order and limit; and (6) the review budget is raised to 40 files and 3600 lines for the complete producer-consumer update. Confirm all six resolutions and close the T3A task frontier?
